headline: Legal Affairs Committee meeting cancelled for March 30, 2026.
summary: The scheduled Legal Affairs/Committee of the Whole meeting was cancelled. No action was taken on proposed amendments to Chapter 117-Animals or on the reappointment of Timothy R. Creamer as Constable.
